params.message:
Move web calls to Retell v3 and ship the export functions as ES modules

Retell removed POST /v2/create-web-call, so every call started from the
studio preview or from a published site failed at connect.

- create-call (export function) and RetellClient::createWebCall post to
  /v3/create-web-call with the same body.
- The v3 response adds transport and ice_servers; the export function
  returns the response whole and ParticipantController::createCall now
  returns both fields too.
- CallPanel passes callId, accessToken, transport and iceServers to
  startCall. retell-client-js-sdk goes from ^2.0.8 to ^3.0.4.
- The export functions are ES modules and carry their own package.json
  with "type": "module".
- RetellClient is bound from config in the container, so the preview
  call route no longer builds it without an API key.

get-call stays on /v2/get-call, which Retell's deprecation notice does
not list.
